FQA FOR SEMESTER EXCHANGE PROGRAM AT FPT UNIVERSITY
Topic Question Information
Exchange semester
Course credit
Insurance
Is it possible to extend my study duration in
Vietnam if I want to stay for a longer period?
Exchange 1 semester or 1 year will be based on the MOU between FPT
University and your Home University
Who is eligible to participate in the exchange
semester at FPT University?
Only undergraduate students can exchange. For graduate students, FPT
University will refuse.
What documents are required for registration
in the exchange program at FPT University?
When studying abroad in FPT University, Internatinal Student need 6 types of
documents including: 
- English Certificate 
- Portrait photo 3x4 cm 
- Academic Official Transcript (English) 
- Copy of Passport 
- Insurance Certificate 
- Recommendation Letter
What is the credit calculation method of FPT
University?
FPT University is a member of UMAP and will follow the UMAP credit transfer
system. So for the Asian market, the credit will be similar. However, with the
European market, usually a student will have to take 30 ECTS to complete a
1-semester program, but when converted to UMAP, 5 subjects will only get
about 22.5 ECTS. Therefore, in addition to classroom hours, FPT will also
calculate the number of hours studying at home of students to calculate 1
subject equivalent to 6 ECTS. From there, 1 course of FPT will be equivalent
to ECTS.
Why do international students need to buy
insurance when studying in Vietnam?
Previously, FPT University did not have any special requirements about
insurance for International students. However, due to the Covid-19 epidemic
and the government's request, the student's insurance must cover at least
10,000 USD in hospital fees for the treatment of covid-19.

I am unsure about which insurance plan to
purchase. Can FPT University provide any
recommendations?
Students can refer to 2 insurance of My April and Luma Health.
How to get the Visa Stamp? Once FPT University receives the Visa information, the coordinator will
provide student with the "Visa approval letter" and "Letter of admission".
Subsequently, Student are required to bring these two documents along with
their passport to the Vietnamese Embassy in home country to obtain the Visa
Stamp.
If there is no Vietnamese Embassy in my
country, how can I get the Visa Stamp?
In the case of Student residing in a country without a Vietnamese embassy,
you can get the Visa Stampt by bringing the aforementioned documents to Tan
Son Nhat airport (at Ho Chi Minh City). It is essential to note that Student must
enter the correct airport to obtain the visa stamp; otherwise, you will be unable
to secure the visa and will need to return to your home country.
What is the duration of my Visa? Can I
extend for more days?
The duration of the visa is calculated as: 7 days before the semester starts +
the program duration + 7 days after the semester ends. Please note that visa
extensions are not accepted for any reason.
What should I do if I do not have any English
certificates but still want to study at FPT
University?
If the International Student does not have English Certificates (IELTS, TOEIC,
CEFR, etc.) at the time of application, ask your Home University to write a
confirmation letter stating that you are qualified to study abroad.
In the course list of FPT University, there are
many subjects for international students to
choose from. Can we sign up for any course
we want?
Each Exchange Semester offers different courses, and the Coordinator will
send the Official course list to students for class registration.
Are those all the courses available for
registration, or are there any other options?
If many students want to study courses that are not included in the official list,
the Coordinator will contact the training department to request more courses
When is the deadline for course registration? International students must provide sufficient information regarding course
registration at least 5 weeks in advance from the date of admission. This
timeframe allows FPT University to effectively arrange classes.
Can International students study a Course
outside of their major at home university?
Students can experience courses that are different from their major when they
exchange at FPT University
I don't know how to find housing when
studying in Vietnam, does FPT University
have any support?
FPT University will support international students to find housing while
studying in Vietnam. To get your desired accommodation, fill out your request
in the "Housing Form" sent by the Coordinator.
